image_description: Two black professional audio loudspeakers positioned side-by-side against a white background. The speaker on the right is angled to show its front face, featuring a large central woofer cone and a smaller tweeter horn at the top, both protected by a perforated metal grille. The speaker on the left shows its side profile and partial front, revealing a similar driver configuration behind a finer mesh grille. Both units have a rectangular enclosure shape with visible wheels/casters at the base.

The side panel of the left speaker exhibits a slight curvature that contradicts the rigid rectangular geometry expected of a wooden/MDF enclosure, though this could be lens distortion.
